## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person/Contact** — core entity; fields visible: name, stage, created date, last visit date, last communication date, last text received date + snippet, phone number(s), assigned agent, tags
- **Smart List** — saved filter set with a name, ID, and dynamic count; belongs to a user/team; has columns configuration
- **Collection** — a named group of contacts (different from smart list; may be a static or action-plan-based grouping)
- **Tag** — string labels on contacts; used in filters (include/exclude); examples: `compliance`, `Expired`, `Withdrawn`, `Unsubscribed`
- **Stage** — pipeline stage value on a contact; examples: `Buyer`, `Expired Listing`, `Active Client`
- **Phone** — contact's phone number with attributes (good/bad/mobile/landline); "Phone is good" filter indicates a boolean "is_valid" or "is_mobile" field
- **Communication** — last communication timestamp; type-agnostic (call, email, text combined)
- **Text Message** — separate from general communication; tracked independently with body snippet
- **Agent/User** — assigned broker; "Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan" → many-to-many contacts-to-agents relationship

### Fields / Enums
- **Stage values (visible):** `Buyer`, `Expired Listing`, `Active Client` (excluded by filter)
- **Tag values (visible/inferred):** `compliance` (or `compliance:hard-stop`), `Expired`, `Withdrawn`, `Unsubscribed`
- **Column group types:** Details, Assigned, Emails, Calls, Texts, Website activity, Deals, Inbox Apps, Custom Fields — reveals the data taxonomy of a contact record
- **Email column sub-types:** Last Email, Last Sent Email, Last Received Email, Last Sent Batch Email, Last Sent Automation Email, Last Sent Marketing Campaign, Emails Sent (count), Emails Received (count), Last Email Activity
- **Phone action types:** call (dialer), text (SMS compose)
- **Filter operators visible:** `exclude any of` (NOT IN), `include any of` (IN), `includes any of` (same), `more than` (greater-than threshold for dates/durations), `is good` (boolean attribute)
- **Segment/View:** Named segments filterable on top of smart list filters (e.g., "Out Of State Homeowners") — suggests a second layer of filtering/grouping
- **Person count per list:** integer, shown in left rail badge and "Showing X people" label (may differ — badge = total matching, "showing" = current page)
- **Last Text Received:** stores timestamp + message body snippet (first N chars of last text received)

### Relationships
- Person → many Tags
- Person → one Stage (from a pipeline)
- Person → one or many Agents (assigned_to)
- Person → many Phone numbers
- Person → many Text messages (last one surfaced as column)
- Person → many Emails
- Person → many Communications (aggregate)
- Smart List → many Filter conditions (AND logic)
- Smart List → one Columns configuration (per list or per user?)
- Collection → many Persons (static or rule-based grouping)

```
        label="Phone is good"
        expanded={false}
      />
      <FilterChip
        type="tags"

        values={["Unsubscribed"]}
        label="Tags exclude any of: Unsubscri..."
        expanded={false}
      />
      <FilterChip
        type="agent"

        label="Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan"
        expanded={false}

```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart List vs Collection:** FUB has two types of saved contact groups. "Collections" appear to be action-plan or lifecycle-stage groupings (pipeline-based). "Smart Lists" are dynamic saved-filter sets that auto-update in real time. Both live in the left rail under different sub-headers.

2. **Columns picker — two-panel pattern:** The Columns dropdown uses a master-detail two-panel layout. Clicking a category in the left panel populates checkboxes in the right panel. Active columns per category are tracked by count (e.g., "Emails (1)" means 1 email column is active). Toggling checkboxes likely auto-saves without a confirm button.

3. **Filter count badge (7):** The "Filters (7)" toolbar button badge counts all active filter conditions. When the filter sidebar is open (default on this screen), the badge still shows. This implies the sidebar is a persistent panel, not a modal.

4. **"Update List" button:** This is specifically for persisting the current filter set as the smart list's definition. It is NOT "apply filters" — filters are already live. This saves the filter state so the smart list refreshes automatically for other sessions / future visits.

5. **"Phone is good" filter:** FUB has a boolean data quality flag per phone number ("is_good" or "is_valid"). This filters out contacts whose phone is missing, invalid, or DNC-flagged at the phone-number level.

6. **Two phone icons per row:** Green call icon is always shown when a phone exists. The blue/purple text icon is shown only when the phone number is an SMS-capable mobile line. Some rows show only the call icon, indicating a landline on file.

7. **Stage badge vs tag badge:** "Expired Listing" appears as a stage (FUB pipeline stage), not just a tag. The filter "Tags include any of: Expired, wi..." is separate and refers to a tag named "Expired" or similar. Both exist independently — a contact can have the stage "Expired Listing" AND a tag "Expired."

8. **Text snippet in Last Text Received cell:** Shows both a relative age ("7 months ago") and a message body preview. This implies the cell is rendering data from the most recent inbound OR outbound text thread — likely the last text in either direction, with a character truncation.

9. **Segment dropdown ("Out Of State Home..."):** A secondary filter layer on top of the smart list's 7 base filters. This allows slicing the same smart list by a named "segment" without modifying the smart list itself. Useful for bulk-action campaigns targeting a subset.

10. **Left rail count badges:** The badge on "All Expireds" reflects the live count of contacts matching the smart list's saved filters. "Showing 24 people" in the header may reflect a sub-page of that total, or may reflect additional in-session filtering (the segment dropdown may further narrow the count to 24 out of a larger pool).

11. **Pagination:** Not explicitly visible but implied by "Showing 24 people" — the list likely has more rows navigable via next/prev controls or infinite scroll below the visible viewport.
